project_type: Python stdlib web app (http.server) with vanilla JS frontend (Three.js from CDN)
build_system: None - pure stdlib Python, no pip install, no build step
test_framework: unittest (stdlib). Test files in backend/tests/test_*.py. Run from project root.
verification_instructions: Run tests from project root: python3 -m unittest discover -s backend/tests -p 'test_*.py' -v. All 243+ tests must pass.
setup_instructions: No setup needed - Python 3.9+ stdlib only. Run: python3 backend/main.py for server on port 8000.
environment_constraints: Python stdlib ONLY (no requests, no pandas). All comments must be in Polish. Prices must be brutto (with 23% VAT). PSE API at api.raporty.pse.pl requires SSL context with verify_mode=CERT_NONE. Data available from 2024-06-14 onwards, 96 records per day (15-min intervals).
contribution_requirements: Zero external dependencies. Polish comments. Brutto prices. Battery charges from PV only (no grid arbitrage).
key_patterns: Services in backend/services/, models in backend/models/, data in backend/data/. API handlers in backend/api/handlers.py. Tests use unittest.TestCase. Frontend is vanilla JS with ES6 modules. PSE API: https://api.raporty.pse.pl/api/rce-pln with OData $filter=business_date eq 'YYYY-MM-DD'. Returns {value: [{rce_pln: float, period: str, business_date: str, ...}]}. 96 records per day (15-min). Prices in PLN/MWh.
directory_structure: backend/ (Python services, models, data, tests, api), frontend/ (HTML, JS, CSS), .kiro/ (steering, backups)
